mix_notes.m1: VOCR5-N arm F's fine-tune mix (eval/vocr5_run.sh N F) with its real half split in two: VOCR5's pinned real pools at half their weights (0.25) and the hooked corpus' train split (horizontal lines and names; hval and guard pages out) at 0.25. Synthetic half unchanged (nv 0.225 + s2 0.1125 with fa=0.15, s3v3 0.1125, s4 0.05).

hooked.what: vocr6-ingest's pools v1 (post-audit, 09:21Z): train split only (hval and guard pages out); horizontal line + name pools, native crops in console polarity

guarded.rule: eval/vocr6_guard.py: a row of a hooked title's VN whose normalised label equals one of that title's hval lines leaves the screening copy (owner pool 75 ink / 62 GRAD rows per variant, teacher_train 1 row); final models use the pools as pinned by eval/vocr5_pools.sha256

log_note: the --val sets are logged only: every run's model is its final step (ckpt_step<steps>.pt)

scoring.path: W8I C runtime greedy + top-8; counter re-decode 6000/4000; beam 8 + vocr_lm_o3_1000k (alpha 500, beta 3500, gate 8000, EOS, bracket 8000) when the greedy text is not empty; Rubi core/textnorm.c; the non-Japanese line filter; no cascade (stage 4 adds it)
scoring.rubi: bee-san/Rubi_for_vita main bd130a8 (core/vocr_ocr.c, core/textnorm.c identical to 56a831c, which reports/vocr5-analysis read)
scoring.dev_exclude_why: v12188 is the hooked train title PCSG00576 (seen); v18432 is the hooked test title PCSG00807 (Dance with Devils), kept out of selection
scoring.check: the dev part reproduces reports/vocr5-analysis's VOCR5-N console-view numbers exactly: crops identical (6,424), no-cascade tv 0.65 / dn 0.6601 / wd 3.2606, with the cascade 0.5125 / 0.6241 / 3.0169
scoring.hval_plan_note: 2,097 of 2,193 hval pages (46 titles; 2 pages with a label in doubt have no regions), 6,327 region units (base/+4/+8), 3,184 clean crops (3,170 dialogue, 14 names); PSP in the 2x console view

decision.metric: dialogue CER, rubi path (scoring.path), console view

components.hval_page: the decision metric: every hval page's whole-dialogue regions (base, +4, +8 px; vocr6-ingest's page pool, which keeps every other box out of a region) through the C finder VOCR_LINES_TEXTBOX_RECOVERY (+ refinement on PSP) in the console view, over the region units whose finder output has no junk box (a finder box covering no reference line); merged lines, missed lines and the finder's imperfect crops all count; clusters = titles
components.hval_page_all: the same over every unit, junk boxes included (report)
components.hval_clean: hval dialogue lines as clean crops, clusters = titles (report)
components.dev: 0.25 tv + 0.25 dn + 0.5 wd (VOCR5's development score, console view) without dev_exclude_vns, clusters = VNs, tv/dn/wd resampled independently

decision.adopt: Y over X iff the hval_page interval of mean(Y) - mean(X) lies below 0, every seed pair's hval_page point difference is below 0, and the dev interval does not lie above 0 (plans/vocr6-plan.md section 7: better on hval page-path dialogue CER and not worse on the unseen-game dev sets, game-bootstrap 95% intervals, across seeds)

page_metric_evidence.measured: 2026-10-26 09:30-09:50Z, before any VOCR6 run, on VOCR5 blobs only (the released v5f_N_seed3, the other VOCR5-N seeds v5f_N_seed1/2, VOCR5-S, VOCR5-L): CER points, title-bootstrap 95% intervals (5,000 resamples)
page_metric_evidence.junk_units: 413 of 6,327 region units (6.5%, 5.6% of the reference characters) have a finder box that covers no line; on one title (PCSG00854) the finder boxes an ornament band above the text, which models read as 'そしtu0100...' (one kana passes Rubi's non-Japanese filter)
page_metric_evidence.conclusion: over all units the page path ranks recognizers by what they read into junk boxes on one title (the same recipe's seeds differ by up to 0.8 points); without the junk units it agrees with the clean crops and the dev score and resolves 0.1-point differences. Junk boxes stay a finder problem (vocr6-finder, T3) and a stage-2 recognizer factor (empty-label negatives), reported as hval_page_all.

A15.what: full fine-tune of VOCR5-N (its own fine-tuned checkpoint, seed 1 = v5f_N_seed1, seed 3 = the released v5f_N_seed3)

B15.what: VOCR5-N's synthetic-only pretrain (pre5_N_seed*, 150,000 steps of nv + s2 + s3v3 + s4, never a real line), then this fine-tune

C50.what: random init, the same mix from the first step (the pretrain's lr 2e-3, 1,000 warm-up steps)

decision.primary: the long budgets A45, B45, C150 (converged accuracy); short budgets and the short -> long gain are reported with each run's slot-hours (cost)
decision.incumbent: VOCR5-N as released (v0.3.0 VOCR5_N_w8.vocr = v5f_N_seed3 step 15000), scored on the same plans; for each pair it is X for both seeds
decision.winner: W1 = the long-budget arm with the lowest mean hval_page CER whose dev interval against VOCR5-N does not lie above 0. W2 = the next lowest if W1 is not adopted over it (decision.adopt); W2 is carried into stage 2 only if it is another family and costs no more new slot-hours than W1
decision.budget: stage 2 and 3 screen at the winner family's short budget; stage 4 uses the long budget iff long is adopted over short for W1 (decision.adopt, the short runs as X)
decision.seen: VOCR5 trained on the owner's console captures of 38 of the 49 hooked titles' VNs (vocr6-ingest overlap): arm A and the VOCR5 incumbents carry that exposure into hval; the screening copies of the owner pool and teacher_train drop the rows that repeat an hval line (data_pins.guarded), so B, C and A's new steps do not see them
decision.compute: est. N: ~6,250 steps per slot-hour (VOCR5-N's fine-tunes: 15,000 steps in 2 h 24 min); A15/B15 ~2.4 h, A45/B45 ~7.2 h, C50 ~8 h, C150 ~24 h per run; 12 runs ~102 slot-hours

amendments.before: any stage-1 run started (the experiment log has no stage-1 line; the only numbers seen are the VOCR5 incumbents' in decision.page_metric_evidence)
amendments.why: compute: C150 costs ~48 of stage 1's ~102 slot-hours, and stage 2 needs slots while the 45k runs train; the plan asks for Hyperband-style early stopping with enough warm-up for the fresh-init arm (vocr6-lead prompt, step 2)
amendments.c_rung: C150 (seeds 1, 3) runs only if C50 is in contention after both C50 seeds are scored: mean hval_page(C50) - min(mean hval_page(A15), mean hval_page(B15)) <= +0.50 points AND mean dev(C50) - dev(VOCR5-N) <= +0.75 points (means over seeds 1, 3; rubi path). Otherwise family C stops at 50k (its numbers are reported) and decision.winner is taken over A45 and B45 only. The thresholds are set from the prior evidence on longer schedules: VOCR3's 4x longer FL10 pretrain gave -0.85 development points (docs/vocr3.md); train2's longer fine-tune was not better (docs/train2.md, F15b)
amendments.pipelining: replaces decision.pipelining: stage 2 starts when A15 and B15 (both seeds) are scored, from W15 = the better of A15 and B15 by decision.winner's rule applied to the short budget (lowest mean hval_page whose dev interval against VOCR5-N does not lie above 0), at that family's short budget. If the long-budget decision later makes the other family (or C150) W1, every factor stage 2 adopts gets one confirmation pair on W1 in stage 4 (W1 + factors against W1)
amendments.order: A15 and B15 first (both seeds), then A45 and B45; C50 from the start on its own slots
